title: Cartwise Shopper Batches Mileage and Long-Distance Rate Card
content:
Mileage pay and the long-distance bonus on Cartwise Shopper Batches are measured on the estimated route shown on the offer. For every batch type the distance mileage pay is computed on is the **estimated route**, never the miles actually driven.

| Batch type | Mileage rate (USD per mile) | Included miles (covered by base pay) | Mileage dispute tolerance | Long-distance threshold (miles) | Long-distance bonus (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shop-Only Batch | 0.00 | 0.0 | 0 percent | 0.0 | 0.00 |
| Express 30 Batch | 0.60 | 0.0 | 15 percent | 0.0 | 0.00 |
| Single Delivery Batch | 0.50 | 1.0 | 15 percent | 10.0 | 2.00 |
| Double Delivery Batch | 0.50 | 1.0 | 15 percent | 10.0 | 2.00 |
| Triple Delivery Batch | 0.50 | 1.0 | 15 percent | 10.0 | 2.00 |
| Stock-Up Batch | 0.65 | 0.0 | 15 percent | 15.0 | 3.00 |

## What each column means

- **Mileage rate** — pay per mile of the estimated route beyond the included miles.
- **Included miles** — route miles already covered by the base pay.
- **Mileage dispute tolerance** — actual miles above the estimate by more than this percentage can be adjusted on dispute; a tolerance of 0 means the batch type carries no mileage pay.
- **Long-distance threshold** — the estimated route above which the long-distance bonus is added; a threshold of 0 means the batch type carries no long-distance bonus.
- **Long-distance bonus** — the bonus amount of the batch type.

## Reading the rate card

- The Shop-Only Batch carries neither mileage pay nor a long-distance bonus; the Express 30 Batch carries mileage pay but no long-distance bonus.
- The Stock-Up Batch has the highest mileage rate (0.65) and the highest long-distance threshold (15.0 miles) and bonus (3.00).
- Hypothetical illustration: an estimated route of 6.4 miles on a batch type with a 0.50 rate and 1.0 included mile gives 5.4 paid miles, and 5.4 multiplied by 0.50 is 2.70.
